question: How should the nyāsa and related rites be performed in this context?
premises: The procedure follows the Bhairavī model.
All elements beginning with nyāsa are included.
This entire set is prescribed as authoritative.
inference: The complete nyāsa and associated rites are to be performed in the same manner as for Bhairavī.
plain_english: All the rites beginning with nyāsa are considered to be performed just as in the Bhairavī practice.
